name: ReGain
one_liner: BetterHelp's online couples and relationship therapy: a licensed therapist by video or phone, plus messaging, paid by weekly subscription.
best_for: Couples who want relationship therapy together from home
People working on a relationship on their own
People who want to message a therapist between sessions

People who don't want their data handled by a company with a recent FTC privacy order
short_description: Subscription online relationship therapy from BetterHelp: one weekly video or phone session plus messaging, about $70–$100 a week.
long_description: ReGain is the couples and relationship counseling service of BetterHelp, Inc. You can join as an individual or as a couple, and one subscription covers both partners. ReGain's own pages say a subscription includes one live session a week by video or phone and in-app messaging, typically $70 to $100 a week depending on location and therapist; the App Store listing shows $60 to $90 a week billed every four weeks. Its privacy policy says website visitor data can be disclosed for targeted advertising if you opt in to ad cookies. ReGain is named in the FTC's 2023 complaint against BetterHelp, which ended in an order banning the company from sharing health data for advertising and $7.8 million in refunds. We found no published study of ReGain itself; it offers talk therapy from licensed counselors.
patient_summary: You sign up alone or with your partner, get matched with a licensed therapist, and have one live session a week by video or phone, with messaging in between. You pay a subscription of about $70–$100 a week, billed weekly or every four weeks; one subscription covers both partners, and financial aid may be available.

pricing.notes: ReGain says price depends on location, preferences and therapist availability; the App Store listing shows $60–$90/week billed every 4 weeks. One subscription covers both partners. Financial aid may be available. Insurance is not mentioned.

basis.regulatory_action: FTC order, 2023: BetterHelp (which also does business as ReGain) shared health information with advertisers; $7.8 million in refunds and a ban on sharing health data for ads

privacy.notes: Visitor data can be disclosed for targeted advertising if you accept ad cookies (counted as a 'sale' under California law); all members can request erasure; a 2023 FTC order covers BetterHelp and ReGain.

seo.title: ReGain: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: ReGain is BetterHelp's online couples and relationship therapy service, by messaging, phone or video with a licensed therapist.

faqs.a: About $60–$90/week, billed every 4 weeks. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with ReGain before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can ReGain replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: ReGain connects you with licensed professionals, so it can be a route into real care. It isn't an emergency service: if you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
ReGain is available on iPhone, Android and the web.
Couples or individual sessions; Shared private room; Unlimited messaging; Video and phone sessions.
